biotools.summary: VerityMap is a tool for mapping long reads to assemblies of extra-long tandem repeats, producing SAM files and identifying potential heterozygous sites and assembly errors through analysis of rare k-mers. It supports PacBio HiFi and ONT reads and generates interactive HTML plots for variant analysis.
